project.title: HL-1 mRNA interactome -  The Cardiomyocyte RNA-Binding Proteome: Links to Intermediary Metabolism and Heart Disease
project.projectDescription: RNAsfunction as compositionally diverse ribonucleoprotein (RNP) comlplexes, formed through interactions with RNA-binding proteins (RBPs). We explored the murine cardiomyocyte RBP repertoire.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: RNA was crosslinked with UV light and subsequently mRNA was captured with oligodT beads, the interactome was detemined using protein digest and lableing approaches, followed by LC-MS/MS analysis
project.dataProcessingProtocol: raw data was analysed with MaxQuant version 1.3.0.5 and the search output was subsequently interpreted with limma and R

references.referenceLine: Liao Y, Castello A, Fischer B, Leicht S, Föehr S, Frese CK, Ragan C, Kurscheid S, Pagler E, Yang H, Krijgsveld J, Hentze MW, Preiss T. The Cardiomyocyte RNA-Binding Proteome: Links to Intermediary Metabolism and Heart Disease. Cell Rep. 2016 Aug 2;16(5):1456-69
